title: Timeline with positioned dots
summary: A vertical line on the list, with each dot absolutely placed on it at the start of its entry.
explanation: Each entry is position: relative, which makes it the box its dot is placed against. The dot is absolute with left: 0, so it sits at the entry's left edge, and top: 4px so it lines up with the first line of text.
The vertical line is the timeline's own left border on the list. Dots get z-index: 1 so they paint on top of the line, and a white outline so the line looks interrupted behind each one.
tryThis: Remove position: relative from .entry: every dot jumps to the top-left corner of the timeline.
Change top: 4px to top: 20px: the dots now sit below the first line of each entry.
Remove z-index from .dot and check whether the line now covers it.
